issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְחֶסֶד לְאֻמִּים חַטָּאת' means 'but the kindness of the nations is sin' (i.e., the mercy shown by the nations/peoples is sin), not 'lòng nhân từ đối với các dân thì là tội' which reads as 'kindness toward the nations is sin.' The Vietnamese reverses the relationship: in Hebrew, the nations are the subjects of the kindness (their kindness), not the objects. This changes who is doing the kindness and to whom.
